CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 9 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 9 OF
2002
LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
(An order to amend certain
laws relating to Local Government Elections)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th March, 2002]
F. No.2(4)/2002‑Pub.,
dated 4‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the Chief Executive is hereby published for general Information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend
certain laws relating to Local Government Elections for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
Now, Therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, read with the Chief Executive's
Order Nos.5 and 9 of 1999, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to
make the following Order:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Local
Government Elections Laws (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

4. Bar of Jurisdiction: ‑No Court shall question the
legality of any action taken in good faith by or under the authority of the
Chief Election Commissioner, a Returning Officer, Presiding Officer or an
Assistant Presiding Officer or any decision given by any of them or any other
officer or a authority appointed under this Order or the rules.
5. Protection of action taken
in good faith.‑‑‑No suit prosecution or other legal
proceeding shall lie against the Chief Election Commissioner of any officer
or other person it respect of anything which is in good faith done or
intended to be done under or in pursuance of this order or of any rule or
order made or any direction given thereunder.
6. Power to make rules.‑‑‑The
Chief Election Commissioner may with the approval of the President, make
rules for carrying out the purposes of the Order.'
